title: On the accuracy in modelling the statistical distribution of Random Telegraph Noise Amplitude (IEEE Access 2021)
publisher: Liverpool John Moores University repository / IEEE Access
supports: RTN amplitude distributions proposed as lognormal, exponential or Gumbel give substantially different tail predictions; GEV fit had lowest error (via search snippet; resp-pixel-stack RT-CIRC-02/RT-DEV-01: tail shape is a measured, not assumed, quantity)

title: An assessment of the statistical distribution of Random Telegraph Noise time constants
supports: RTN time constants are broadly distributed; basis for treating the fraction of traps active within a 15 ns CDS gap as an unknown to measure (via search snippet; resp-pixel-stack)

title: On-chip RTN statistics in 45 nm CMOS (Columbia Bioelectronic Systems Lab)
supports: Poisson number of traps per device and log-normal dVth; the 95th-percentile amplitude tail scales with gate dimensions (via search snippet; resp-pixel-stack supports enlarging the SF gate to 0.02 um2)

title: Baby Steps Toward 3D DRAM
supports: Lam proposes wider/shorter horizontal capacitors; Samsung has not disclosed how it will reach stacked 3D DRAM; no incumbent per-tier cell area or capacitor length disclosed (via search snippet; resp-pixel-stack RT-IND-02)

title: SemiWiki forum post on a multilayer horizontal 3D DRAM cell
supports: Academic horizontal-cell 3D DRAM with unit cell 0.280 x 0.435 um, ~525 Mb/mm2 at 64 layers (low confidence, forum; resp-pixel-stack RT-IND-02: no public incumbent cell size, so A1 base/optimistic remain the proxies)

title: Low-frequency noise in long-channel amorphous In-Ga-Zn-O thin-film transistors (Fung et al., JAP 2010)
publisher: Journal of Applied Physics / Univ. Michigan
supports: The alpha_H = 1.52e-3 device used a SiO2 gate dielectric (inverted staggered), and annealing lowered noise: low 1/f does not require a PECVD SiNx gate (via search snippet; resp-pixel-stack RT-PROC-02)

title: Scaled ALD IGZO TFT low-frequency noise with PE-ALD Al2O3 gate (Sumi et al., IEEE TED 2025)
supports: Near-interface traps dominate noise and their influence grows in scaled ALD IGZO TFTs; higher In ratio correlates with higher noise (caution for the In-rich depletion SF split) (via search snippet; resp-pixel-stack)

title: LFN of IGZO TFTs vs hydrogen content of the ALD Al2O3 gate insulator (KAIST SSMD)
supports: Hydrogen content of the ALD gate insulator, set by deposition temperature, changes IGZO low-frequency noise: gate-H is a noise variable to split, not only a retention variable (via search snippet; resp-pixel-stack RT-PROC-02)

title: IGZO TFT LFN, Al2O3 vs Al2O3/SiNx gate (Cho et al., IEEE EDL 2009)
supports: SiNx interlayer cuts normalized noise 2-3 orders vs Al2O3-only by suppressing remote phonon scattering; an interlayer, not SiNx specifically, is the lever (via search snippet; resp-pixel-stack RT-PROC-02)
